title: Troubleshooting: bearing wear
text:
Placeholder text (mock).

Symptoms:
- High-frequency vibration energy rises first.
- Overall vibration RMS and bearing temperature follow later.

Typical progression to seizure is about 2 days at full load.

title: Safety: lockout/tagout before any work
text:
Placeholder text (mock).

1. Stop the pump from the local panel.
2. Open and lock the motor isolator; attach your personal tag.
3. Close suction and discharge valves.
4. Verify zero energy before opening any housing.

title: Procedure: bearing replacement
text:
Placeholder text (mock).

Remove the coupling guard, pull the drive-end bearing with the puller, heat-fit the new 6309 C3 bearing, re-grease and reassemble.

title: Procedure: laser shaft alignment
text:
Placeholder text (mock).

Mount the laser heads, take readings at 9-12-3 o'clock, shim the motor feet, and record final offsets.

title: Procedure: lubrication (re-greasing)
text:
Placeholder text (mock).

Use EP2 lithium grease. Apply 15 g per bearing through the grease nipple while running at low speed.
